lead.headline: Trump defends Russia sanctions waiver, says Zelenskyy wants war to go on
lead.dek: Bessent declines three times on NBC to call Ukraine an ally; two Republicans seek a Starlink probe
body: President Donald Trump on Sunday defended his waiver of new sanctions on Russia, writing on Truth Social that he did not want to "drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table" and that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy "doesn't want to end this war, and probably never did."

Zelenskyy told NBC's "Meet the Press" that the United States siding with Russia would be a "historic mistake" and that Ukraine "will not prevail" if the two align. He said intelligence sharing was blocked for three days and that SpaceX's Starlink limits followed a "message from American government." Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, asked three times whether Ukraine is an ally, did not say.

Trump signed the waiver Friday, two days before the sanctions took effect, after announcing a deal Oct. 9 for Russia to ship more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel. Rep. Mike Turner and Sen. Kevin Cramer, both Republicans, called on CBS for a congressional inquiry into the Starlink disruption, which Secretary of State Marco Rubio said no one ordered.

briefs.headline: Trump endorses Netanyahu 9 days before Israel votes
briefs.summary: Trump called Netanyahu a "Great Warrior Prime Minister" on Truth Social Sunday after withholding an endorsement for months as the two split over Iran and Gaza. Israelis vote Oct. 27.

briefs.headline: Grand jury indicts Irvine woman accused of spying for China
briefs.summary: An indictment filed Oct. 9 and reported Sunday charges Wanying Zhang, 34, with conspiracy and acting as an unregistered agent; prosecutors say she surveilled a son of Taiwan's president near Seattle for a Chinese official.

briefs.headline: Wichita police release truck driver without charges
briefs.summary: Police named the dead as Cole Adrian, 6, and Nicholas Schafer, 35, both of McPherson, and said the 34-year-old driver was released pending toxicology and a mechanical exam. Intent is unclear.

briefs.headline: Airman dies after fall in pregame rappel at the Alamodome
briefs.summary: Tech. Sgt. Ian Patterson, a 15-year Air Force instructor, fell from the rafters before Saturday's UTSA-Navy game in San Antonio and died at a hospital, Nellis Air Force Base said. The game was played.

briefs.headline: Macron keeps interior minister who says police 'lost control'
briefs.summary: Macron declined Laurent Nunez's resignation Monday and ordered a review of planning failures. The ministry said over 2,300 were arrested and almost 1,000 officers hurt; 350 more were held in Paris Sunday.

briefs.headline: Israeli police arrest 10 over settler attacks on journalist, diplomats
briefs.summary: Police said the pre-dawn operation Monday followed Friday's beating of Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine and Saturday's attack on European diplomats. Netanyahu called the Levine facts "unclear."

briefs.headline: Ebola reaches 8th Congo province as Kenya confirms 8th case
briefs.summary: Congo's Health Ministry recorded two cases, one fatal, in Nord-Ubangi on the Central African Republic border Sunday. The outbreak declared in May counts at least 9,400 cases and over 4,500 deaths.

briefs.headline: Lula, Bolsonaro trade insults in first debate a week before runoff
briefs.summary: Lula called Sen. Flavio Bolsonaro "a habitual liar, a thug" Sunday; Bolsonaro said Lula should keep his distance "because my wallet could be stolen." Two polls this week read 51-49 for Bolsonaro.

briefs.headline: PSC eases 69% coal-plant rule in revised power regs
briefs.summary: The 51-page order says utilities need not run a unit at a 69% capacity factor if that would raise rates, judged over rolling 12-month periods; the Legislature reviews the rules next.

briefs.headline: DEP filings project heavy impacts from Mason data centers
briefs.summary: Permit documents forecast significant environmental impacts from two Mason County projects; DEP preliminarily approved an air permit for Nscale's 2.16-gigawatt microgrid north of Point Pleasant.

briefs.headline: PSC hearing on NextEra's MARL line opens Oct. 26
briefs.summary: More than 140 landowners, groups and county commissions intervened against the 500,000-volt line through 59 miles of West Virginia; the hearing runs to Nov. 2.

briefs.headline: Valley Link sets November open houses on 765 kV line
briefs.summary: The AEP, Mon Power and Dominion venture holds 12 drop-in sessions Nov. 4-19 on the Valley North line from the John Amos plant, including Nov. 5 at Sissonville Middle School.

regional.item: Two juveniles were flown to Huntington after a train hit their pickup at a private crossing in Leon Sunday, state police said.
A man arrived at CAMC General with multiple gunshot wounds late Saturday; police said the shooting near Temple Street was isolated.
The Simms Powell Pavilion opens with a 4 p.m. ribbon cutting today; its courts and event space start as rental-only for lack of staff.

away.item: Bennington votes Nov. 3 on a 1% local option tax the town estimates at $1.8M a year, the Banner said Sunday.

hotspots.item: Nearly 60 people turned out in Cowen on Oct. 7 for the opening of the B.A.R.E. Truth Community Hub, offering recovery, mental health and housing help, the Echo said.
North Topsail Beach says public comments on the Army Corps' draft EIS for the New River Inlet master plan are due today, Oct. 19, per an Oct. 13 town post.

briefs.headline: Skakun and Sabo win Prince George school board seats
briefs.summary: Incumbents Cory Antrim and Craig Brennan lost. Sarah Holland topped the poll with 6,593 votes; Erica McLean took the last seat with 4,308, two behind Sabo.

briefs.headline: B.C. Conservatives' costed platform carries $10.8B deficit
briefs.summary: The 71-page plan counts on $2.6B in new revenue from GDP growth of 2.5% to 3.2%, above the Bank of Canada's 1.4% to 1.8%. The NDP said it leaves a $6B gap.

briefs.headline: Eby asks B.C. Green voters to back NDP to stop Conservatives
briefs.summary: Eby said in Campbell River that Green votes put Conservatives ahead of the NDP in 11 ridings in 2024. Green Leader Emily Lowan said he is trying to scare voters.

briefs.headline: Military names 4 soldiers killed in CFB Wainwright fire
briefs.summary: Maj.-Gen. Wade Rutland named Sgt. Morgan Wong and Privates Shaun Farrell, Aidan Goulding and Hayden Lykkemark. Smith said 39 remain in hospital, 19 critical; the cause may take weeks.

briefs.headline: Albertans vote today on a binding separation referendum
briefs.summary: Elections Alberta said 1,356,873 ballots were cast in advance and by mail, 43% of 3,148,343 electors. Separation is one of 10 questions; Ipsos for Global put stay at seven in 10.

briefs.headline: JAXA sets Phobos sample launch for 3:41 p.m. ET
briefs.summary: JAXA said the H3 rocket's 10th flight will send the Martian Moons eXploration probe from Tanegashima toward Phobos. Backup dates run to Nov. 9.

briefs.headline: Daily glacier model adds up to 10% to sea-level rise
briefs.summary: A 12,500-glacier model run daily rather than monthly raised the projected sea-level contribution 5% to 10%, ETH Zurich researchers said in Nature Communications.

briefs.headline: Coral contact reverses bleaching in seven weeks in lab
briefs.summary: Bleached fragments held against an identical healthy coral recovered in seven weeks; separated pairs died, Stanford researchers said in Science Advances.

briefs.headline: Weights and measures body votes to end leap seconds
briefs.summary: The General Conference on Weights and Measures voted to stop inserting leap seconds, citing risk to critical infrastructure. Continuous UTC starts in 2027.

briefs.headline: Two German courts hold Google liable for AI summaries
briefs.summary: The Aachen Regional Court barred Google from repeating three AI Mode passages about a physician, with fines to 250,000 euros per violation. Munich ruled the same way in May.

briefs.headline: Microsoft benchmark finds agents misjudge long tasks
briefs.summary: The best of 14 models scored 59.7% on 502 agent decision points, and 21% when the deciding clue came late, Microsoft and City University of Hong Kong researchers said.

briefs.headline: Disney to hire at least 60 Character.AI employees
briefs.summary: A bankruptcy filing says Disney will offer jobs to at least 60 Character.AI staff, an estimated $60M a year in pay, after agreeing to buy some assets for $20M.

weather_ear: Monday's forecast files at 7:15, from Jim Claudtore's desk.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster and Summers-New River carry no regional line today; Cowen appears in Vacation Hotspots.
